about: The Ultimate Challenge's own rounds: never played on the Board or in Defuse. Cambridge formats only, written around the traps B2 First actually sets.

rounds.prompt: By the time we arrived, the concert ___.
rounds.note: Earlier than another past moment: past perfect.

rounds.prompt: I ___ here since I was ten.
rounds.note: since + a point in the past: present perfect.

rounds.prompt: This time next week, we ___ on a beach in the Algarve.
rounds.note: An action in progress at a future moment: future continuous.

rounds.prompt: She ___ for two hours when her phone finally rang.
rounds.note: Duration up to a past moment: past perfect continuous.

rounds.prompt: Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
rounds.note: A prediction from what you can see now: going to.

rounds.prompt: The train ___ at 7:15 tomorrow morning, so don't be late.
rounds.note: Timetables use the present simple, even for the future.

rounds.prompt: I ___ my keys. Can you help me look for them?
rounds.note: A past action with a result now: present perfect.

rounds.prompt: When I was a child, I ___ climb trees in the park.
rounds.note: used to + verb: a past habit that has stopped.

rounds.prompt: By 2030, scientists ___ a cure, I hope.
rounds.note: Completed before a future time: future perfect.

rounds.prompt: I ___ this book three times, and I still love it.
rounds.note: How many times, up to now: present perfect.

rounds.prompt: What ___ when the fire alarm went off?
rounds.note: An action in progress, interrupted: past continuous.

rounds.prompt: He ___ to the gym every day this month.
rounds.note: A repeated activity in an unfinished period: present perfect continuous.

rounds.prompt: I ___ you as soon as I get home.
rounds.note: Future result with as soon as + present.

rounds.prompt: She ___ the piano since she was six, so she's really good.
rounds.note: since + duration to now: present perfect (continuous).

rounds.prompt: It was the first time I ___ snow.
rounds.note: It was the first time + past perfect.

rounds.prompt: I ___ what you mean now.
rounds.note: understand is a state verb: no continuous form.

rounds.prompt: I've known Pedro ___ we were at primary school.
rounds.note: since + a starting point.

rounds.prompt: We have been friends ___ over ten years.
rounds.note: for + a length of time.

rounds.prompt: ___ you ever been to Madeira?
rounds.note: Present perfect question with ever.

rounds.prompt: By the time I got to the station, the train had ___ left.
rounds.note: had already / had just left.

rounds.prompt: I haven't finished my project ___.
rounds.note: yet at the end of a negative present perfect.

rounds.prompt: What ___ you doing at eight o'clock last night?
rounds.note: Past continuous question.

rounds.prompt: She ___ have been working there for five years next month.
rounds.note: will have been working: future perfect continuous.

rounds.prompt: When I arrived, they ___ already eaten.
rounds.note: Past perfect: before I arrived.

rounds.prompt: I'm ___ to visit my grandparents this weekend.
rounds.note: be going to for a plan.

rounds.prompt: He didn't ___ to like vegetables, but now he loves them.
rounds.note: didn't use to (not used to) in the negative.

rounds.prompt: This is the best meal I have ___ eaten.
rounds.note: superlative + present perfect + ever.

rounds.prompt: Hurry up! The film starts ___ five minutes.
rounds.note: in + time: from now.

rounds.prompt: While I ___ walking home, it started to snow.
rounds.note: Past continuous for the background action.

rounds.prompt: I'll call you when I ___ finished my homework.
rounds.note: when + present perfect for a future completed action.

rounds.prompt: I started learning Spanish three years ago.
rounds.note: started … ago = have been doing … for.

rounds.prompt: The last time I saw her was in July.
rounds.note: the last time … was = haven't … since.

rounds.prompt: This is my first time on a plane.
rounds.note: first time = have never … before.

rounds.prompt: She left before I got there.
rounds.note: Before another past moment: past perfect.

rounds.prompt: We moved here in 2015.
rounds.note: moved in 2015 = have lived here since 2015.

rounds.prompt: I used to swim every morning, but I don't any more.
rounds.note: not any more = no longer.

rounds.prompt: It's two years since I last went to the cinema.
rounds.stem: I ___ the cinema for two years.
rounds.note: It's two years since = haven't … for two years.

rounds.prompt: The film had started before we arrived.
rounds.note: before = by the time.

rounds.prompt: I'll finish the report before Friday.
rounds.note: before a future time = will have + past participle.

rounds.prompt: When did you start working here?
rounds.note: When did you start? = How long have you been …?

rounds.prompt: Getting up so early is new for me.
rounds.note: be used to + -ing: something familiar.

rounds.prompt: My plan is to visit Rome next summer.
rounds.note: a plan = going to.

rounds.prompt: She was in the middle of cooking when I phoned.
rounds.note: in the middle of = past continuous.

rounds.prompt: I haven't eaten sushi before.
rounds.note: the first time + present perfect.

rounds.prompt: The meeting is scheduled for 3 p.m.
rounds.note: Timetabled events: present simple.

rounds.prompt: It's ages since she wrote to me.
rounds.note: It's ages since = hasn't … for ages.
